variant.title: Friendly Sudoku
variant.description: The number above the grid tells how many cells match their row, column, or box number.
rule.friendly_sudoku: A cell is friendly when its digit equals its row, column, or box number. The number above the grid is the exact total.
rule_guide.title: Friendly Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: A cell is friendly when its digit equals its row number, column number, or box number.
rule_guide.item_3: The number above the grid is the exact number of friendly cells in the completed puzzle.
